title: Son, father 66: violent dizziness, double vision, can't walk

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 88 Judah Street. It's my dad, he's 66.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He suddenly got super dizzy, like the room is spinning really bad, and he's seeing two of everything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, he tried to get up and he can't walk, he almost fell over.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About twenty minutes ago. We were watching TV and he was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does he take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, he doesn't take anything like that.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep him sitting down.
